description: Concessions pour la construction de parc éoliens dans la Partie Belge de la Mer du Nord is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Institut royal des Sciences naturelles de Belgique (IRSNB). This dataset represents the location of the windfarms concessions in the Belgian Part of the North Sea. Coverage: Institut royal des Sciences naturelles de Belgique (IRSNB). The portal shows the English title as "Windfarm concessions" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Institut royal des Sciences naturelles de Belgique (IRSNB). Its keywords include Reporting INSPIRE, Federale Overheid, marine spatial planning, Gouvernement Fédéral, Bundesregierung, Marine essentials. The listing shows 2 download or service links in XML. The listing shows 2026-06-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
